input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, meeting the preferred position. Clause 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to engage any supplier and records that Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment, and clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-flavoured covenant (clause 12.4, Vendor shall not develop or market a competing analytics service) runs against Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. No redline is warranted.
